questions.q: What did Aunt Sylvie use to identify Tom among the tomato vines and jimson weeds?
questions.explain: Aunt Sylvie used her cat to find Tom hiding among the garden plants.

questions.q: Why did Aunt Sylvie shout from the open door?
choices: to call out to her lost nephew
questions.explain: Aunt Sylvie shouted to locate her missing nephew.

questions.q: What does Tom's aunt find on his hands and mouth after catching him hiding?
questions.explain: Tom's aunt found jam on his hands and mouth, indicating he had been eating it.

questions.q: What did Aunt Polly want to do with the boy who was missing?
questions.explain: Aunt Polly searched for the missing boy in the house and garden.

questions.q: What did Aunt Polly find when she looked under the bed?
questions.explain: Aunt Polly found the cat under the bed while searching for the missing boy.

questions.q: What did Aunt Polly use to look for Tom?
questions.explain: Aunt Polly used her spectacles to look for Tom as she thought he had gone missing.
